s: Mi shemmotze chametz betok hammoed ubo ch' seipim: hammotze bepesach chatikat chametz shello metzaah bibdiqat lel y"d, ben shemmetzaah bebeto ben shemmetzaah bekol maqom shehu birshuto, im hu chol hammoed — chayyab lebaaro min haolam miyyad sheyyirenna, vibarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al biur chametz", ap al pi shekkebar bittel kol chametzo belel y"d, mikkol maqom chayyab lebaaro middibre soperim, shemma yishkach veyoklenna, vechayyab lebarek kemo shemmebarekin al kol mitzvot middibre soperim. (Veap al pi shekkebar berak al biur chametz belel y"d, ubibraka zo niptar millebarek al biur beyom y"d, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"b), mikkol maqom lo niptar ella keshemmebaer et hechametz shemmatza babbediqa o et hechametz sheqqana laakilat y"d, lepi shekkol zeman shello bier et hechametz shemmatza babbediqa hare adayin lo nigmera habbediqa shebberak aleha, shebbediqa belo biur enah shava kelum, ulepikak kol chametz shemmebaer qodem sheggamar lebaer et hechametz shemmatza babbediqa en tzarik lebarek alayv, lepi sheadayin lo nigmera mitzvat habbediqa shebberak aleha. Vaapillu lo matza shum chametz babbediqa — en tzarik lebarek keshemmebaer beyom y"d et hechametz shehaya yadua lo bishat habbediqa sheyyitztarek lemachar lebaaro, sheggemar habbediqa hu zeh. Vaapillu keshemmebaer chametz acher shello haya yadua lo bishat habbediqa, kegon shehaya tamun bechor bishat habbediqa ubadaq velo metzao veachar kak nitgalgel mishsham umetzao, o shennimlak lemachar veqana chametz, o shennimlak leepot lechem chametz — en tzarik lebarek al biuro, im mebaaro qodem sheggamar lebaer et hechametz shehaya yadua lo bishat habbediqa sheyyitztarek lebaaro, kevan sheadayin lo nigmera mitzvat habbediqa, shehare berak aleha "al mitzvat biur", vaadayin lo gamar lebaer et hechametz shehaya yadua lo bishat habbediqa sheyyitztarek lebaaro. Abal keshemmebaer hechametz shemmatza leachar sheggamar lebaer et hechametz hayyadua lo bishat habbediqa sheyyitztarek lebaaro — chayyab lebarek alayv, shehare kebar nigmera mitzvat habbediqa shebberak aleha:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmebaaro leachar shehiggia shaa shishshit, abal keshemmebaaro qodem shaa shishshit — en tzarik lebarek alayv ap al pi shekkebar gamar lebaer kol hechametz shehaya yadua lo bishat habbediqa, lepi shekkol zeman shello higgia shaa shishshit adayin lo nigmera mitzvat habbediqa, shehare eno bodeq ella kede lebaaro min haolam, vekol zeman shello higgia shaa shishshit en tzarik lebaaro, venimtza shello asa kelal mitzva bibdiqato ubebiuro ad shehiggia shaa shishshit veen chametz nimtza birshuto, azay lemaprea asa mitzva bibdiqato ubebiuro. Veepshar sheap keshemmebaer mishshaa shishshit vaelak ad hallayla en tzarik lebarek alayv, ella im ken mebaaro betok happesach, dekol shello higgia happesach adayin lo nigmera mitzvat habbediqa vehabbiur, shehare eno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" ub"bal yimmatze" ad hallayla, velo tzivveta tora lebaer hechametz beereb pesach mechatzot hayyom ulemala ella kede shello yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" betok happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"b, venimtza dikshemmaggia happesach nigmera lemaprea mitzva min hattora bemah shebbadaq ubier et hechametz mereshuto. Usepeq berakot lehaqel:

(Vekol zeh) kesheyyesh kezayit bachatikat chametz zo shemmatza betok happesach, abal im en bah kezayit lo yebarek al biurah, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheppachot mikkezayit chametz en tzarik lebaaro kelal im kebar bittelo qodem happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t veyesh lachosh ledibrehem shello lebarek al biur pachot mikkezayit chametz, shekkol sepeq berakot lehaqel:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmatza chametz shennitchammetz qodem happesach, shekkebar bittelo kesheamar "kol chamia ku'", abal im nitchammetza lo issa betok happesach, sheen beyado lebattelo akshav, ap al pi sheen bah kezayit chayyab lebaaro ledibre hakkol, gezera mishshum kezayit shalem sheober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora, ulepikak chayyab lebarek al biurah. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennitchammetza chimmutz gamur sheyyitbaer besiman tn"t, abal im lo nitchammetza chimmutz gamur, veken chitta hannimtzet betabshil o shennishret bemayim sheap al pi shennitbaqqea enah chametz gamur kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"z — lo yebarek al biurah ap al pi shennitchammetza betok happesach:

Veim matza chatikat chametz bebeto beyom tob o beshabbat, apillu yesh bah kezayit lo yebaarenna bo bayyom, ella yikpeh aleha keli ad haereb lekassotah min haayin shello yishkach veyoklenna, ubaereb yebaarenna. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechametz shennitchammetz qodem shebbittel chametzo bey"d, sheeno ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora, abal bechametz shennitchammetz bepesach — hare zeh mebaaro apillu beyom tob, kede shello yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veketzad mebaaro? Im yesh lepanayv nahar — yeparerennu veyashlikennu lannahar, veal yisrepennu, kede lemaet bechillul yom tob. Veim en lepanayv nahar — yisrepennu o yeparerennu veyizreh laruach. Veap al pi sheshshebitat yom tob yesh bah mitzvat aseh velo taaseh kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ttz"h, ubiur chametz bepesach en bo gam ken ella mitzvat aseh "tashbitu seor vego'" velo taaseh "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", veen dochin aseh velo taaseh mippene aseh velo taaseh, mikkol maqom kevan shemmeleket hahabara vehazzeriyya laruach huttera beyom tob min hattora letzorek akila — huttera legamre apillu shello letzorek akila, ubilbad sheyyihyeh bahen tzorek yom tob, kegon letzorek mitzva oberet shezzemannah bo bayyom, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ttz"h, ubiur chametz gam ken hi mitzva oberet, shehare kol rega verega shemmashheh oto veeno mebaaro ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim daapillu nitchammetza bepesach — lo yebaarenna beyom tob, vaapillu yesh lepanayv nahar — lo yashlikenna lesham, dekevan shehechametz asur bahanaa bepesach — hare hu muqtzeh, veasur letaltelo beyom tob, shehare eno rauy liklum. Veap al pi sheissur tiltul hammuqtzeh eno ella middibre soperim ubiur chametz shello bittelo qodem happesach hu min hattora, sheober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", mikkol maqom chakamim heemidu dibrehem bimqom aseh velo taaseh, sheyyesh koach beyad hachakamim laaqor dabar min hattora be"sheb veal taaseh", kelomar sheeno ober mitzvat hattora beyadayim, ella hu yosheb ubatel vehi mitbattelet meeleha. Vaapillu lisrepa bimqomah asur. Ap al pi sheeno metaltelo, umeleket hasserepa huttera letzorek akila — en omerim shemmittok shehuttera letzorek akila huttera letzorek mitzva, kevan shemmin hattora epshar leqayyem hammitzva belo chillul yom tob, dehaynu sheyyashlikennu lannahar o lebet hakkisse, shehare tiltul hammuqtzeh eno asur ella middibre soperim. Veken yakol min hattora leparer velizrot laruach, velo ameru shehazzoreh hu meabot melakot, ella bezoreh tebua kede lehaprish mimmenna et hammotz shehu borer (okel mittok happesolet) (pesolet mittok haokel), abal keshezzoreh kol haokel laruach — en kan issur min hattora. Ulepikak asur lisrop hechametz beyom tob min hattora, vei epshar lachakamim lehattir dabar haasur min hattora, ella kopeh alayv keli ad haereb. Veal shehiyya zo shemmashheh et hechametz ad haereb — eno ober be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", kevan shehu rotzeh lebaaro ella shechakamim moneim oto — hare hu anus, velo hizhira tora "bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" ella lemi sheyyesh beyado lebaer:

Uleinyan halaka, bemaqom shennohagin kassebara harishona — en limchot beyadam. Abal bemaqom sheen minhag — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Umikkol maqom, yakol lomar lenokri sheyyashlikenna lannahar o lebet hakkisse. Vaapillu beshabbat yakol lomar ken, raq shello yaabirenna bemaqom sheasur letaltel min hattora. Vaapillu nitchammetza qodem shebbittel chametzo bey"d sheeno ober alayv min hattora, mikkol maqom middibre soperim mitzva lebaarah, ukebar nitbaer besiman sh"z shekkol dabar sheasur laasoto beshabbat middibre soperim muttar lenokri laasoto im yesh bo tzorek mitzva.*[Abal lo yomar lenokri leparer velizrot laruach apillu beyom tob, kevan sheyyesh omerim sheyyesh bizriyya zo melaka gemura min hattora, kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"t ayyen sham. Vaapillu nitchammetza betok happesach sheyyesh kan mitzvat biur min hattora, ap al pi ken chakamim heemidu dibrehem velo hittiru lomar lenokri laasot melaka gemura letzorek shum mitzva mimmitzvot hattora, chutz mimmitzvat mila kemo shennitbaer besiman shl"a]. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyom tob rishon shehu min hattora, abal beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot sheeno ella middibre soperim — yesh lismok al sebara harishona keshennitchammetza betok happesach veyesh bah kezayit sheober be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora. Umikkol maqom, im epshar lo lehashlikah lebet hakkisse o lannahar, lo yisrepenna velo yizrenna laruach, kede lemaet bechillul yom tob. Veken im epshar al yede nokri, lo yaaseh al yede yisrael. Ukeshehu mebaer al yede nokri lo yebarek, kevan shehu beatzmo eno meqayyem hammitzva. Veakshav en nohagin lebaer al yede nokri, apillu lomar lo lehashliko lannahar, vaapillu beyom tob sheni shel galuyyot, lepi shechosheshin lesakkana, shello yomar hannokri: "keshapim hu oseh li":

Gaggo shel nokri shehaya samuk legaggo shel yisrael venitgalgel hechametz miggaggo shel nokri legaggo shel yisrael, im hu chol hammoed o ereb pesach mishshaa shishshit vaelak — hare zeh dochapo beqaneh legaggo shel nokri o lirshut harabbim, gezera shemma yabo leekol mimmennu kesheyyaaleh al gaggo lehishtammesh sham. Abal lo yetaltelennu beyadayv lehachaziro legaggo shel nokri, kede sheyyihyeh lo hekker al yede dechipat haqqaneh velo yishkach al issur chametz velo yabo leekol mimmennu akshav beshaa shemmachaziro legaggo shel nokri. Umittaam zeh asur ligga bechametz shel nokri kol yeme happesach. Abal muttar ligga bechametz shel yisrael beshaa shemmitasseq lebaaro min haolam beereb pesach o bechol hammoed, veen lachosh shemma yishkach veyoklenna, kevan shekkol atzmo eno mitasseq bo ella kede lebaaro min haolam heak yishkach veyoklenna. Veim matza beshabbat o beyom tob chametzo shel nokri shennitgalgel legaggo — lo yidchepennu beqaneh, shehare metaltel muqtzeh, sheasur letaltel muqtzeh apillu al yede dabar acher kemo shennitbaer besiman shy"a, ella yikpeh alayv keli ad haereb, veaz yidchepennu beqaneh legaggo shel nokri o lirshut harabbim:

Matza pat bebeto bepesach veeno yodea im chametz o matztza — hare hu muttar apillu baakila, shebbevadday matztza hi, shehare badaq kol habbayit qodem happesach ubier kol hechametz shehaya bo. Vaapillu matza pat zo begumma o bechor, en chosheshin shemma lo raa otah bishat habbediqa, shemmin hassetam badaq kedino bachorin ubassedaqim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g ayyen sham. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehaggumma hi megulla, shebbevadday raa otah keshebbadaq, umin hassetam badaq betokah, abal im matza pat begumma sheeno niret lakkol, kegon shemmatza becharitz shebbeshule hatteba vehi mekussa beqarshe shule hatteba veen nireh lakkol sheyyesh sham charitz — yesh lachosh shemma pat zo hi chametz, vechayyab lebaaro min haolam miyyad. Vaapillu matza pat beemtza habbayit ella shehi meuppeshet, im hi beinyan shei epshar lah lehitappesh mishshenniknas happesach (o mishshaa sheapa matztzot bazzeman hazzeh sheopin qodem happesach) — hare nikkar haddabar shebbevadday hi shel chametz, vechayyab lebaarah miyyad. Abal im aberu kol kak mime happesach (o mishshaa sheapa hammatztzot) beinyan sheyyesh litlot shennitappesha bishhiyyatah mishshenniknas happesach (o mishshaa sheapa hammatztzot) ad atta — tolin lehaqel umutteret apillu baakila, kevan shebbadaq et habbayit qodem happesach. Veim nohagin beoto bayit leepot bepesach pat chamma bekol yom, tolin lehaqel apillu im pat zo shemmatza hi meuppeshet harbeh, sheanu omerim: pat chamma apa bekol yom veyom vehinniach pat hachamma al pat zo shemmatza ulekak hirbeta lehitappesh:
